# GrowGuest — Digital Growth & Direct Booking Pipeline for Hospitality

> GrowGuest is a specialized, founder-led digital marketing consultancy exclusively serving independent hotels, resorts, homestays, and dining venues. We build end-to-end direct booking engines that eliminate 15-25% OTA commissions (MakeMyTrip, Agoda, Booking.com) and rank properties #1 on Google Maps.

## Primary Services

1. **Google Business Profile (GBP) & Map Pack SEO**: Dominating local searches like "hotels near me" or "resort in Nagpur", optimizing map categories, geotagging room photos, removing duplicate spam listings, and acquiring 5-star Google reviews.
2. **Paid Ads Management (Google Ads & Meta Ads)**: Running high-ROI Google Search Ads, Google Hotel Ads, and targeted Instagram Reels/Facebook campaigns with Click-to-WhatsApp triggers to deliver instant, high-intent room inquiries.
3. **Hospitality OTA Management & Optimization**: Complete management of MakeMyTrip, Agoda, Booking.com, and Goibibo listings. Achieving 95%+ content scores, defending rate parity, channel manager calendar synchronization, and leveraging the Billboard Effect to convert OTA guests into direct bookers.
4. **Social Media Management & Visual Storytelling**: Cinematic short-form video reels, drone footage, dining showcases, monthly content calendars, and automated Instagram DM-to-WhatsApp booking funnels.
5. **Direct Booking Website Conversion Fixes**: Designing sub-1.5s mobile speed direct booking websites that turn lookers into direct guests without middleman fees.
6. **Hospitality Local & Technical SEO**: Keyword strategy targeting high-intent traveler searches ("boutique stay Mukteshwar", "luxury resort Wardha Road").
7. **WhatsApp Booking Automation**: Integrating 1-click WhatsApp reservation triggers with automated greeting flows and staff closing scripts.
